card.name: Glucose and insulin treatment wording
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'containing', 'with' and 'a' right after dextrose, glucose or insulin in lists of treatments for high potassium or sugar problems. Also some word endings in lab terms like triglyceride and fatty acid levels.

modes.label: Dextrose with insulin
modes.description: The word 'containing' or 'with' joining a dextrose or glucose solution to its insulin addition.
modes.example: Dextrose Injection USP, 10% or 25%,<< containing>> 10 units of crystalline insulin

modes.label: Insulin and potassium shift
modes.description: The word 'a' after 'insulins ... cause' before 'shift in potassium'.
modes.example: All insulins, including HUMALOG, cause<< a>> shift in potassium from the extracellular to

modes.label: Lipid or glucose lab terms
modes.description: The last part of a lab measure name just before 'levels'.
modes.example: increased triglycer<<ide>> levels. Impaired glucose tolerance.
